title: Device code: wrong or expired
summary: Three states of the device-code page as frames: a wrong code (the error at the field, Continue kept) an expired code (a neutral callout that the device shows a new code, with one way on) and too many tries (a neutral callout with the time to try again, no dead-end button). Neither names a product and neither is a dead end.
compare: Wrong code: the field keeps its danger edge and the reason in one sentence under it; the code stays as typed so one character can be fixed.
Expired: a neutral callout (DL6), not an error, with the fix as the one primary; it never says whether a device or product was behind the code.
No product, art or developer on either frame; the footer is the same as the entry page.
Too many tries (frame 3): a neutral callout says when to try again; no button, never a disabled primary.
The wrong code keeps its danger edge (aria-invalid) as well as the sentence under it (m1).
